title: Two accounts
suits: reconciliation, audit, matching and anomaly claims: two records of the same thing (invoice vs payment, order vs shipment, contract vs claim) and the one line they disagree on

params.--field / --brand / --brand-2: field; the question chip (brand, with the mark); the match lines (brand-2)
params.--st-two-accounts-alert: the mismatch colour (alert coral by default)
params..st-two-accounts-row: four label + value rows per document; the third (.st-two-accounts-off) disagrees
params.<u> in the values: the digits that differ get an underline

details: the two documents slide in from opposite sides, each turned a little, and settle with a 10 px overshoot
each has its own soft shadow that starts a beat late and catches up
a paperclip on the invoice, a folded dog-ear on the bank record that unfolds as it lands
the match lines draw one after another, top to bottom, each a gentle S-curve
a white dot pops at each end of a line as it is reached
the mismatch line draws dashed in the alert colour
both amounts light up and pulse twice, the right one a beat after the left
only the two swapped digits are underlined (24 vs 42)
the question chip carries the product's mark, drops from above, squashes on the mismatch line, hops and swings to rest 4° off true
its shadow grows as it falls and tightens when it lands
a faint diagonal light band and a pool of light on the field, drawn from the field's own ink
